Ask one question of the resolved call/type graph

Usage: ryi graph [OPTIONS] <--callers <NAME>|--uses <NAME>|--from <NAME>|--call-path <NAME>|--type-path <NAME>|--flow-path <BLOB@START:END>> [PATH]...

Arguments:
  [PATH]...  Files, directories, or globs; - reads a path list from stdin

Options:
      --pattern <GLOB>              Keep files matching GLOB under each directory input; repeatable
      --entry <FILE>                Run on the files FILE reaches over imports (universe: the PATH inputs, else FILE's project)
      --depth <N>                   Import hops from --entry
      --root <DIR>                  Corpus root
      --callers <NAME>              Resolved call edges landing on NAME
      --uses <NAME>                 Declarations that reference type NAME
      --from <NAME>                 Everything NAME reaches along call edges
      --call-path <NAME>            Shortest call paths from NAME
      --type-path <NAME>            Shortest type-reference paths from NAME
      --flow-path <BLOB@START:END>  Flow paths from BLOB@START:END
      --sqlite <PATH>               Keep the fact store in a new SQLite database at PATH
      --slow                        Walk the SCIP oracle's edges (ryi slow) instead of the syntax resolve
      --timeout <SECS>              Seconds the question may run; past it graph exits 3 [default: 30]
      --at <REV>                    Query a committed revision
      --compare <REV>               Diff the answers against REV
      --scip-index <FILE>           Load this index.scip
      --rust-checker                Add rust-analyzer type evidence
      --ts-checker                  Add TypeScript checker type evidence
      --go-checker                  Add go/types type evidence
  -h, --help                        Print help
